evals.prompt: We want to A/B test a new onboarding screen. We get about 2,000 sign-ups per week and 30% complete onboarding. Design the experiment.
evals.expected_output: An experiment brief with decision rule, hypothesis, primary and guardrail metrics, a sample size calculation using the given baseline, a duration in full weeks, and a pre-set stopping rule.
expectations: Uses the 30% baseline and states the minimum detectable effect chosen
Duration is computed from 2,000 sign-ups per week and given in full weeks
Decision and stopping rules are written before launch
Includes at least one guardrail metric
